clips.title: The story
paras: In Gnomeregan's lower depths, researchers seek a potent sample of radioactive fallout. They hope to learn how the sludge afflicted the leper gnomes and find a cure.

Deep in the Hall of Gears, irradiated horrors, lurkers, and slimes move through the lowest tiers of Gnomeregan. Researchers outside the fallen capital need fallout drawn from these living creatures. Samples scraped from contaminated scavengers outside are too weak for their work. The sludge decays quickly, so it must go into a leaden phial and reach the researchers before it loses its potency.

Ozzie Togglevolt and his colleagues seek a cure for the leper gnomes. They believe the secrets of the irradiated sludge may point the way. During the trogg invasion, toxic venting deformed and drove these survivors mad. They remain trapped in a living nightmare, and the researchers consider dangerous expeditions into the ruins worth the risk.
